gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9401 covers seats and parts thereof; ch.94 note 1(d) excludes only parts of general use of base metal, a recliner mechanism is specific to seats
GRI 6: 9401.99 parts other; not motor vehicle, cane or plastic, so 9401.99.90 Other

rejected_alternatives.reason: mounting fittings; a recliner mechanism is a specific seat part (Sec XV note 1(k)/ch.94)

classification.rationale: Metal recliner mechanism is a part of seats of heading 9401; N012776 classified the same article in the old Parts/Other/Other line, which is now 9401.99.90; suffix 85 is the current Other.
